task.title: Make the desktop sidebar's project rows keyboard-reachable
task.description: The sidebar's project rows are <li> elements with a click listener, no tabindex and no role, so Tab skips every project. The Next entry added by the Next view is a <button>, as are the Next view's rows, so the rail is now reachable up to Next and then stops. Make each .project-item a <button> (or give it role=button and tabindex=0 with Enter/Space handling) so the whole sidebar is navigable end to end. Found by the adversarial review of the Next view branch.
